name: Legolizer Subdivision
definition: A GPU-based iterative subdivision strategy that refines a triangular mesh until all edge lengths are smaller than or equal to a user-defined cube size r, ensuring uniform sampling for subsequent voxelization.
summary: Legolizer Subdivision is a GPU-based iterative mesh refinement strategy that subdivides triangles until edges are smaller than a target voxel size, ensuring watertightness for LEGOr voxelization.
